title: Direct Drik Panchang five-planet Asta windows — five Indian cities, 2024–2028
captureMethod: Playwright Chromium direct named-city event pages with geoname-id; city and planet verified in rendered page body
provenancePolicy: City-label-only source evidence. Drik observer coordinates/elevation are not disclosed. A page with zero extracted rows is not treated as a zero-event year unless the rendered page explicitly says Total Asta Duration = 0 Days.
normalizationRule: For source clocks above 24:00, preserve the original printed date/weekday/clock and add floor(hour/24) days to produce the normalized civil local instant; UTC is IST minus 05:30.
